androidBuild: Three embedded-layout arm64 debug APKs; release smoke recorded independently

device.systemGles: GLES: Qualcomm, Adreno (TM) 830, OpenGL ES 3.2 V@0800.64.8

performance.method: Three process-cold starts per host following first installation and warm filesystem caches. Force-stop between launches, rotating host order. Each run skips 30 submissions and samples 180 successful main-thread submission callbacks. PSS collected after samples. Reported p50 and p95 are medians of three per-run nearest-rank quantiles. No GPU timestamp or display presentation fence.

minifiedRelease.variant: R8 optimized release build signed with the local debug key
